LanguageData.RT_T90M_MainBattleTank_Blueprint.label: T-90M
LanguageData.RT_T90M_MainBattleTank_Blueprint.descrip:
The T-90M main battle tank is the final upgraded type of the T-90A tank,it's absolute the mainstay of the Russian Federation's armed forces.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Gunner x1，Commander x1
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel:</color> Chemfuel

<color=#b0e0e6>CE Ammo:</color> 
125mmCannon（Main Cannon）
12.7x108mm（Support MG）
7.62x54mmR（Coaxial MG）
